steps.detail: Parent turn interrupt; manager schedules descendant cleanup in the background.
steps.boundary: Parent interrupt and descendant sweep have separate completion timing.

steps.detail: Sweep active children from the current descendant snapshot; mark handled only after a non-null interrupted turn ID.
steps.boundary: Snapshot can be stale; per-child failures are caught and logged.

steps.detail: Discover the descendant tree again after pass 1.
steps.boundary: Failed or incomplete discovery can leave descendants undiscovered.

steps.detail: Skip already handled children and try the local manager or in-progress turn interrupt for remaining active children.
steps.boundary: Best-effort per-child sweep, not an atomic tree operation or completion receipt.

steps.detail: Panel invokes child interrupt callbacks without awaiting their promises; loading can clear while manager work continues.
steps.boundary: No tree-wide acknowledgement proves every child stopped.

establishes: The local Lab's five checkpoint controls are interactive and show matching explanatory copy.

does_not_establish: A live Codex Desktop Stop all interaction or child interrupt result.

limitations: Manual review of a local Lab explanation page, not a test suite.
